goal: Revamp B2B SaaS Landing Page into a World-Class, Human-Grade Product Showcase and Overhaul Admin Command Center
context: User feedback: the current landing page and admin dashboard look like generic AI-generated templates with cramped fonts and lack visual elegance. Overhauled into Stripe/Linear and Bizfly BizChatAI grade designs with bespoke SVG iconography, Bento grids, interactive simulator, ROI calculator, and dynamic context-aware AI copilot.
requirements: Eliminate AI-cliché visual tropes: remove excessive emojis, tacky neon blobs, and generic cards.
Adopt top-tier design system: refined typography, Bento grid layout, realistic device mockups, subtle border glows, and clean SVG icons.
Embed interactive Live Product Simulation right on the landing page allowing visitors to test conversational shopping without leaving.
Build an interactive ROI / Savings Calculator with range sliders for daily chat volume and staff headcount.
Detail authentic Vietnamese business case studies and social proof (Hanoi fashion, HCMC footwear, agency multi-shop management).
Add comprehensive FAQ addressing Zalo/Facebook policy compliance, setup time, data isolation, and future POS/ERP integrations.
Polish VietQR registration modal with instant QR rendering and copyable bank account credentials.
Overhaul Admin Command Center with 14.5px+ readable typography, spacious 3-column split, dynamic context copilot chips, and Order Draft summary card.
acceptance_criteria: Landing page delivers premium aesthetic without AI-generated look; interactive simulator and ROI calculator operate smoothly; admin typography is spacious and legible; all 24 E2E tests pass.
